title: A Fine-tuning Dataset and Benchmark for Large Language Models for Protein Understanding (ProteinLMBench)
authors: Yiqing Shen, Zan Chen, Michail Mamalakis, Luhan He, Haiyang Xia, Tianbin Li, Yanzhou Su, Junjun He, Yu Guang Wang
plm_baselines: None (no pLM or specialized protein LLM baselines evaluated)
code_and_data_released: Dataset and benchmark on Hugging Face and GitHub; no train/test split documentation (Datasheet Q12: 'No.').

methods.datasets: ProteinLMDataset (17.46B SSL tokens from PMC/PubMed/UniProtKB + 893K SFT instructions) and ProteinLMBench (944 six-choice MCQs generated by GPT-4/RAG reading downloaded papers).
methods.evaluation_protocol: LoRA continual pretraining (50B mixed tokens) + SFT (850K samples, 3 epochs) on InternLM2-7B evaluated against 16 off-the-shelf general LLMs on 944 six-choice MCQs.
methods.controls_included: SFT-only ablation (InternLM2-Protein-7B w/o SSL: 58.26% vs 62.18% SSL+SFT vs 54.98% base). No train/test deduplication or sequence-dependence control.
methods.compute_and_tools: Fine-tuned model trained on 50B domain tokens vs off-the-shelf general LLMs.

key_results.notes: Datasheet Q12 confirms no train/test split; ProteinLMDataset trains on PMC/PubMed/UniProt while ProteinLMBench was generated by GPT-4/RAG from the downloaded research papers, creating direct corpus overlap.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: Literature spans up to 2024 with no temporal holdout between training corpora and ProteinLMBench.

homology_overlap.evidence: Appendix Datasheet Q12 explicitly states no splits exist ('No.') and Q13 acknowledges near-duplicate sequences mapped to the same papers.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: SSL trains on 320,000 PMC full texts and >3M PubMed abstracts while ProteinLMBench was generated by an LLM reading the downloaded papers (Appendix Q22).

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Automated BERN2 NER/NEN linking, no multi-seed runs, unexplained near-chance Qwen1.5-7B (21.73%), and Table 3 formatting artifact.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: InternLM2-Protein-7B receives 50B-token domain SSL + 850K SFT while all 16 general LLMs are evaluated off-the-shelf.

baseline_fairness.evidence: Zero pLMs or specialized protein LLMs (BioT5, ProLLaMA, Galactica) evaluated.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: Data is on Hugging Face, but there is no train/test split and no breakdown of sequence-dependent vs text-trivia questions.

takeaway: Continual pretraining and SFT of InternLM2-7B on ProteinLMDataset lifts ProteinLMBench accuracy from 54.98% to 62.18%, above off-the-shelf GPT-4.0-turbo (57.94%). Because no train/test split or homology deduplication separates the PMC/PubMed training corpus from the paper-generated MCQ benchmark and no pLM baselines were run, corpus memorization cannot be ruled out.
